selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is being asked about in this passage?
questions.answer: It is about why the five daily prayers are set at certain times.

questions.question: How many reasons for the prayer times are explained here?
questions.answer: Only one reason is explained here.

questions.question: Besides marking a change, what else does each prayer time show?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s power at work and His blessings in the world.

questions.question: Why are people told to glorify Allah more at those times?
questions.answer: Because those times show His greatness in a special way.

questions.question: Why are people told to praise and thank Allah more at those times?
questions.answer: Because many blessings gather between one prayer time and the next.

questions.question: What do the set prayers mean in this passage?
questions.answer: They mean giving glory, praise, and thanks to Allah at these special times.

questions.question: What does the reader need to do to understand this deep meaning a little better?
questions.answer: The reader should listen carefully to the five points that will be explained.

questions.question: What does the speaker say will come after this short explanation?
questions.answer: Five points that help explain the meaning more clearly.

questions.question: Which prayers are being discussed in this passage?
questions.answer: The five daily prayers.

questions.question: What is special about the times of these prayers according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are tied to important turning points and signs of Allah’s power and gifts.

questions.question: What kind of blessings are mentioned between the prayer times?
questions.answer: Very many blessings that build up during the time between one prayer and the next.

questions.question: What two main things does each prayer time reflect?
questions.answer: It reflects divine power and divine blessings.

questions.question: How does the passage connect prayer with gratitude?
questions.answer: It says prayer includes thanking Allah for the blessings received.

questions.question: How does the passage connect prayer with glorifying Allah?
questions.answer: It says these times call for extra glorifying and honoring Allah.

questions.question: What does this teach a Muslim about prayer times?
questions.answer: They are not random; they are full of wisdom and meaning.

questions.question: What will help someone begin to understand this meaning?
questions.answer: Listening to the five points that follow.

questions.question: What is the main topic of this part of the text?
questions.answer: The wisdom behind the chosen times of the five daily prayers.

questions.question: Is the explanation here complete or partial? How do you know?
questions.answer: It is partial, because it says only one of many examples of wisdom will be given.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens at every prayer time?
questions.answer: A major change begins and Allah’s power and blessings can be seen in it.

questions.question: Why do these times lead to more remembrance of Allah?
questions.answer: Because they remind people of His greatness and what He gives.

questions.question: What should a believer notice between one prayer time and the next?
questions.answer: The many blessings Allah has provided.

questions.question: What is one main purpose of the prescribed prayers in this passage?
questions.answer: To glorify, praise, and thank Allah.

questions.question: Why might the meaning in this passage be called deep?
questions.answer: Because it connects prayer times with big changes, Allah’s power, and many blessings.

questions.question: What does the speaker ask the listener to do before the five points are given?
questions.answer: To listen carefully along with his own inner self.
